text: In Kansas, a car of young women [plunges off a bridge into a muddy river|trigger|a sudden accident or attack], and hours later Mary Henry walks out onto the bank, unable to remember how she survived. She takes a job as a church organist in Salt Lake City, where a [pale-faced man keeps appearing|images|ghosts and strange figures] and an abandoned lakeside pavilion draws her back again and again. At times the town stops seeing or hearing her, her hymns drift into eerie music, and at the pavilion [the ghouls are dancing|threat|the dead that rise].
